title: Bodycam: Jersey Shore Protestor Learns What ‘The Hard Way’ Is
description:
A man was arrested on a beach in Belmar, New Jersey on August 24, 2024, after allegedly refusing to pay for a beach badge. Ryan Schreiber was taken into custody after Belmar Police repeatedly asked him to leave the area or pay for a beach badge. Bodycam video shows Schreiber initially obliged and headed to a free beach access before walking back to the paid area where police encountered the man again. Schreiber’s move comes amid public debate over coastal fees on the Jersey shore. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
